description: Header file defining thread-local cached output tensor and array structures for Torch AOT Inductor, including template specializations and memory management functions.

classes.name: ThreadLocalCachedOutputTensor
classes.description: Template class for thread-local cached output tensors with specializations for different handle types.

classes.name: ThreadLocalCachedOutputArray
classes.description: Template class for thread-local cached output arrays with specializations for different handle types.

methods.name: copy_data_from
methods.description: Copies data from a handle or tensor into the thread-local cache.

methods.name: tensor
methods.description: Returns the tensor handle associated with the cache.

methods.name: arrayref_tensor
methods.description: Returns the array reference tensor stored in the cache.
